promotion_gate.interpretation: Conditional VALID development gate; it does not establish originality, physical synchrony, or final-test performance.

recommendation: retain the registered negative/conditional result and stop this covariance study
audit_notes: All numeric forward replay and intervention outputs were computed on CPU; the independent model formula uses NumPy float64 and exact erf GELU.
Stored A/V grid anchors preserve the registered decoder-time interpolation convention; corpus physical synchrony remains UNVERIFIED.
Validation source intervals are conditional on already-selected models and do not adjust for repeated VALID use.
The paired covariance operator is an established diagonal projected cross-moment; this audit makes no originality claim.
